matches.notes: The pitchside/post-match interviews (players, Gary O'Neil, Régis Le Bris) run from 27:11 to 28:36 and are counted within the highlights segment. The studio analysis widens into Sunderland's season prospects from about 32:11 before handing on to Brentford v Tottenham at 32:54.
matches.handover: Mark Scott was at Portman Road.

matches.notes: Highlights include the post-match pitchside interviews (Keith Andrews, a Brentford player and Roberto De Zerbi) from 41:11 to 42:25; the studio picks up at 42:25 on De Zerbi/Andrews' 'good place' line. Studio analysis runs to 46:53, where the presenter moves on to trailing Sunday's programme.
matches.handover: Steve Bower was at this one.

matches.notes: The pitchside interviews with David Moyes and Pierre Sage (from 54:20) are counted within the highlights; the studio pundits take over at 55:43 ("He is not one to get carried away, is he?") and run until the Nottingham Forest v Leeds intro at 58:18. The 46:53-47:29 stretch before the intro is programme trails/promos, not match coverage.
matches.handover: Crystal Palace's new manager Pierre Sage took his team to Everton, who'd lost their opening game in each of the last four seasons. Your commentator, Steve Wilson.

matches.notes: The exchange at 65:34-65:44 ("The first Leeds manager to win in the top-flight since a certain Don Revie." / "You are in good company.") reads as the tail of the pitchside interview with Daniel Farke rather than studio talk, so it is included in the highlights; the studio is unambiguously back at 65:44 with "That was a great interview from James Trafford". Studio analysis runs to the Arsenal v Coventry set-up at 67:24, via a brief Joe Hart/5Live-style aside at 67:18.

This match was played the previous evening (Friday) and is held over as a full package, shown last in the episode. The highlights segment ends with two pitchside interviews conducted by the commentator (Frank Lampard from 73:22, then Mikel Arteta from 73:50) before the studio picks up at 74:27. Studio analysis runs to the closing table round-up at 78:49.
